Interior features include Bluetooth connectivity, SiriusXM, USB charging ports, steering wheel audio and cruise controls, air conditioning, remote keyless entry, and drive mode select. Additional features include roof rails, privacy glass, heated power mirrors with turn signal indicators, and 17-inch alloy wheels. The Sorento also earned 5-Star Government Safety Ratings, providing added peace of mind.

A practical and reliable midsize SUV that combines space, comfort, and strong V6 performance ideal for families or everyday use.

This is the ultimate commuter car for anyone looking to beat the prices at the pump without sacrificing modern technology. We have just traded for this 2022 Kia Forte FE with 79,950 miles. While the odometer shows higher mileage for a four-year-old vehicleaveraging roughly 20,000 miles per yearthis is the textbook definition of a "highway warrior." This Forte was likely a dedicated long-distance commuter, spending its life cruising efficiently in top gear on I-75 rather than enduring the harsh wear and tear of city stop-and-go traffic. It offers you the sleek, updated styling of the 2022 refresh for an incredibly budget-friendly price.

The "FE" Standard
The "FE" badge stands for Fuel Economy, and it is the absolute smartest choice in the Forte lineup for high-mileage drivers. It strikes the perfect balance between practical utility and everyday comfort:

Class-Leading Fuel Efficiency specifically tuned for the FE trim, delivering a massive 41 MPG Highway. This car pays for itself with the money you will save at the gas station on SR 200.

Durable Woven Cloth Seating which is highly breathable and resists absorbing the intense Florida summer heat, unlike dark leather or synthetic materials.

15-Inch Wheels with Full Covers wrapped in tires with thicker sidewalls. This not only makes replacement tires significantly cheaper, but it also absorbs Ocala's bumps and potholes for a much smoother, quieter ride.

Auto Headlight Control adding daily convenience by automatically turning your lights on at dusk or in heavy Florida downpours.

Connected Cabin
Your compact sedan is a modern digital hub. The 2022 Forte FE features an intuitive 8-Inch Touchscreen Display. Crucially, because this model doesn't have the built-in factory navigation of the higher trims, it comes standard with Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto! This highly sought-after feature allows you to project your Waze navigation, Spotify playlists, and text messages directly onto the dash without ever taking your phone out of your pocket or dealing with messy cords.

The "Forte" Advantage
Kia redesigned the front end for 2022, giving it a sporty, aggressive look while packing it with advanced "Drive Wise" safety tech. This vehicle offers:

2.0L 4-Cylinder Engine delivering a reliable 147 Horsepower paired with an Intelligent Variable Transmission (IVT). It provides smooth, seamless acceleration for merging onto the highway while maximizing every drop of fuel.

Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist acting as a digital co-pilot that monitors the road ahead for vehicles and pedestrians, capable of automatically applying the brakes to prevent a fender bender.

Lane Keeping Assist & Lane Following Assist which uses cameras to monitor lane markers, providing gentle steering inputs to keep the vehicle perfectly centereddrastically reducing driver fatigue on long trips to Orlando or Gainesville.

Spacious Trunk offering 15.3 cubic feet of cargo space, which is massive for a compact car and easily swallows golf clubs, groceries, or luggage for a weekend getaway.

Just Getting Started
Modern 4-cylinder engines are built to go the distance, and 80k highway miles is just the first chapter for a well-maintained Forte. You get the aggressive 2022 styling updates, the highly desirable wireless connectivity, and the absolute best fuel economy in the lineup for a fraction of the cost of a new 2026 model. It has been fully inspected by our certified technicians and is ready to roll.
